items.headline: Deuce Bailey's 3 touchdown passes power Coastal Carolina in 31-20 win over Georgia State
items.description: — Deuce Bailey threw for 297 yards and three touchdowns as Coastal Carolina scored 31 points over the middle two quarters of a 31-20 victory over Georgia State on Saturday.
